interface.title: FSC Error Bar Calculator
interface.stage_of_work: Checking the resolution and quality of a 3D reconstruction after refinement
interface.what_it_is_for: Computes the Fourier Shell Correlation curve between two uploaded half maps and draws confidence bounds from one of three statistical methods (Fisher z, bootstrap, analytical variance), so the 0.143 resolution can be read with its uncertainty and exported as CSV. Sigma sets the bound width for Fisher z and analytical variance; bootstrap always gives a 95% percentile interval.

data.note: The app has no built-in or example data, and the test-data folder was empty (browser_list_files returned no files). Everything before the computation could be explored: the method explanations and equations, the method dropdown, sigma, bootstrap sample count, the upload pickers and Run. The FSC curve, the 0.143 line, the confidence envelope, the results table and the CSV download were never produced.

features.name: Method selector with method-specific parameters
features.general: Choose one of several statistical methods for an uncertainty estimate; parameters that apply only to one method appear when it is chosen and hide otherwise
features.specific: The 'Select error estimation method' dropdown (Fisher Z-transform / Bootstrap / Analytical Variance) shows 'Number of bootstrap samples' only for Bootstrap, and the sample count goes back to 100 each time Bootstrap is chosen again. Sigma stays visible and keeps its value across methods, but only Fisher Z and Analytical Variance use it; Bootstrap always reports the 2.5th–97.5th percentile (95%) interval
steps: pick Bootstrap: the sample-count field appears
switch to Analytical Variance or Fisher Z: the sample-count field disappears; switching back resets it to 100
serves_tasks: Choose the statistical method for the confidence envelope
Set the number of resamples for the resampling method

features.name: Bounded confidence-width input (sigma) with range checking
features.general: Enter a confidence width in standard deviations with steppers; out-of-range values are flagged and steppers turn off at the limits. The width applies only to the parametric methods, not to the resampling method, whose interval is fixed at 95%
features.specific: Sigma number input: 0.1–10 in 0.1 steps, default 3.00, mapped in the usage notes to 68/95/99.7% for σ=1/2/3; used by Fisher Z and Analytical Variance, ignored by Bootstrap. Typing 0 or 50 turns the field red with 'Press Enter to apply'; after Enter a warning icon says 'Number is outside the allowed range. Please enter a value between 0.10 and 10.00.' The bootstrap sample-count field behaves the same way (0 and 100000 were flagged)
steps: type a value and press Enter
out-of-range values show a red field and a range warning
at 0.1 or 10 the matching stepper is disabled
serves_tasks: Set the width of the confidence envelope in standard deviations, for the methods that use it
